neutral.EN: Yes, that was quite an event.
I understand why you bring that up.
neutral.TL: Nauunawaan ko kung bakit mo binuksan 'yan.

neutral.EN: Right. That was a significant moment.
I hear what you're saying about that.
neutral.TL: Naiintindihan ko ang sinasabi mo tungkol doon.

warm.EN: Yeah. I can see why that stayed with you.
warm.TL: Oo. Naiintindihan ko kung bakit hindi mo iyon makalimutan.

warm.EN: I remember that too. It meant a lot to me.
warm.TL: Naaalala ko rin 'yon. Malaking bagay 'yon para sa akin.

warm.EN: That was a special moment between us. Glad you remember.
warm.TL: Espesyal na sandali 'yon sa atin. Mabuti at naaalala mo.

warm.EN: It stayed in my heart as well, friend.
warm.TL: Nanatili rin 'yon sa puso ko, kaibigan.

warm.EN: Thanks for reminding me of that. Good times.
warm.TL: Salamat sa pagpapaalala niyan. Magandang alaala.

warm.EN: Those memories keep us human out here.
warm.TL: Ang mga alaalang 'yan ang nagpapanatiling tao sa atin dito.

warm.EN: I smile every time I think back on that day.
warm.TL: Napapangiti ako tuwing naaalala ko ang araw na 'yon.

warm.EN: We made it through that together. I won't forget it.
warm.TL: Nalusutan natin 'yon nang magkasama. Di ko 'yon malilimutan.

warm.EN: I'm glad we share that memory.
warm.TL: Masaya ako at pinagsaluhan natin ang alaalang 'yon.

warm.EN: That really stuck with both of us, didn't it?
warm.TL: Talagang tumatak sa ating dalawa 'yon, 'di ba?

guarded.EN: I remember, but let's not dwell on the past.
guarded.TL: Naaalala ko, pero huwag na nating balik-balikan ang nakaraan.

guarded.EN: Past is past. Keep your focus here.
guarded.TL: Nakalipas na. Magpokus ka sa kasalukuyan.

guarded.EN: I know what happened. No need to rehash it.
guarded.TL: Alam ko ang nangyari. Di na kailangang ulitin pa.

guarded.EN: Noted. But don't expect me to get sentimental.
guarded.TL: Tala ko na. Pero huwag kang umasang magiging madrama ako.

guarded.EN: Yeah, I remember. Why bring it up now?
guarded.TL: Oo, tanda ko. Bakit mo binubuksan ngayon?

guarded.EN: I haven't forgotten. I never forget.
guarded.TL: Hindi ko kinalimutan. Hindi ako kailanman nakalilimot.
Narinig ko. Lumipat na tayo ng usapan.

guarded.EN: I remember the lesson it taught us.
guarded.TL: Naaalala ko ang aral na itinuro niyan sa atin.

guarded.EN: All right. Keep that to yourself moving forward.
guarded.TL: Sige. Itago mo na lang sa sarili mo sa susunod.
